Hi all —

Following our intake calls, I'd like to propose a single coordinated "cohort" demo on Wed Aug 26 that uses staggered 30-minute blocks so each vendor/prospect gets a short, focused walkthrough and we can reuse common material. This will help our engineering and solutions folks run one consolidated session while still giving each team time for product-specific Q&A.

Proposed structure (PST / EDT / GMT):
- Block A (Intro + Greenleaf): 09:00–09:30 PT / 12:00–12:30 ET / 17:00–17:30 BST
- Block B (Acme): 09:45–10:15 PT / 12:45–13:15 ET / 17:45–18:15 BST
- Block C (Beacon): 10:30–11:00 PT / 13:30–14:00 ET / 18:30–19:00 BST

Notes:
- We propose 15-minute transitions so our engineers can switch context and attendees can hop in/out.
- Each block will be ~20-min demo + ~10-min focused Q&A.
- Priyom will run the infra/ops deep-dive; Lauren will cover security/compliance highlights.

Could you please confirm:
1) Which block you'd like to occupy (A/B/C)?
2) Expected attendee count and titles (so we can prep the right level of detail).
3) Any hard constraints on timing (we can shift by ±15 minutes if needed).

I've attached a draft agenda and a preliminary attendee grid — feel free to edit. If a single consolidated day doesn't work, tell us and we'll split across two afternoons.

Thanks — looking forward to a tight, low-friction session.

— Avery
